title: `Core\Http\Client` has no spelling for "wait forever": every bound is a `Duration`, an omitted one inherits `[http.client]`, and expiry throws `TimeoutError`
divergesFromPhp: curl defaults to no timeout and `file_get_contents` to `default_socket_timeout`'s sixty seconds; here there is no `null`, no `0` and no option that means unbounded, so a long call names its own `deadline`
